meta.title: Farming Consumable and One-Time Modifier Cost Baseline
meta.purpose: Machine-readable normal-cost reference for recurring consumables, temporary account buffs, and single-use modifiers that can affect Farming planning.
meta.refresh_policy: Refresh live Bazaar/Auction House data before any player-facing next-upgrade recommendation. Dated values below are fallbacks and comparison anchors, not permanent prices.

pricing_rules.bazaar: Use current instant-buy for buy-now acquisition. Midpoint may be shown as a rough reference but is not a historical average.
pricing_rules.auction_house: Prefer current lowest sane BIN plus a recent median. Ignore obvious outliers. Do not use the arithmetic mean alone when the distribution is skewed.
pricing_rules.non_coin_currency: Keep Bits, Pelts, Copper, Gems and other currencies explicit. Convert them to coins only when a sourced/user-selected conversion policy exists.
pricing_rules.recurring_cost: Recurring consumables must be amortized over their real active duration. Do not charge the full item cost per farming hour.
pricing_rules.stacking: If a duration can stack, model remaining duration as state and only value the incremental duration purchased.
pricing_rules.double_count_guard: Do not add the same modifier twice when it is also present in a more specialized research snapshot.

external_cross_check.source_crawl_note: Search index crawled about 6 days before 2026-09-17.

items.normal_cost_rule: Use live instant-buy. If live data is unavailable, prefer the repository snapshot because it is the project's same-date baseline; external pages only confirm the ~10m order of magnitude.
items.effect: +1 rarity tier on most eligible items, once per item.
items.farming_value_rule: No global fixed Farming Fortune delta. Recompute rarity-scaled reforge, gemstone, enchantment or item effects for the exact target item before scoring.
items.recoverable_value: Potentially partly recoverable through resale of the modified tradeable item; do not assume 100% recovery.

duration.alchemy_scaling: base duration gains up to +12 hours from Alchemy level; model the profile's actual duration
duration.offline_rule: God Potion playtime does not tick down while the player is offline.

market_reference.outlier_note: Use median rather than mean as the fallback because the 24h maximum is far above the lower cluster.

items.effect: Provides the supported positive potion effects at their God Potion tiers; exact Farming relevance depends on the active potion-effect set and any Mixins.
items.optimizer_rule: Amortize market acquisition over actual online buff hours. Keep the 1,500 Bits route separate from coin purchase unless Bits have an explicit conversion value.
items.special_exclusion: Douce Pluie de Stinky Cheese is not included in God Potion.

duration.offline_rule: Duration is real-time and continues while offline.

items.effect: Cookie Buff for 4 real-life days; includes account/QoL benefits and stat effects such as Wisdom and Magic Find.
items.farming_value_rule: Do not convert all Cookie benefits into Farming profit automatically. Model only verified Farming-relevant effects plus any explicit Bits/reward economics used by the planner.
items.optimizer_rule: Always prefer a live Bazaar refresh. Same-week indexed sources differ materially, so a hard-coded single normal price is unsafe.

items.optimizer_rule: Treat 40 Pelts as an earned-currency/time cost unless a sourced Pelt-to-coin opportunity-cost conversion is selected. Never call the potion free.
The Sprayonator itself is durable. Charge the live cost of the chosen spray material and apply the +50 BPC only while farming on the sprayed plot for the active spray duration.

existing_special_consumables_cross_refer.rule: The specialized file remains authoritative for those same-date numeric snapshots. This consumable file supplies cross-category planning semantics and missing recurring/account consumables.

calculator_integration.non_coin_cost_formula: keep source currency and grind time separate unless an explicit conversion policy exists
calculator_integration.unknown_rule: unknown != 0; missing current price or duration must mark the economic result incomplete
